# Shred-it

> A floating two-stage shredder tool for files: secure delete desktop app for macOS and Windows. Drop files into the Shredder Bin, then burn the bin to overwrite and permanently delete them.

- Repository: https://github.com/ZulfiqarShah9/shred-it
- Downloads: https://github.com/ZulfiqarShah9/shred-it/releases/tag/v1.0.0
- License: MIT
- Version: 1.0.0

## What it does

Shred-it is an Electron desktop app built around `paper-shredder-widget.html`. It provides animated paper-shredder UI, a private bin at `~/Library/Application Support/shred-it/ShredderBin` (macOS) or `%APPDATA%\shred-it\ShredderBin` (Windows), restore-before-burn, and permanent deletion with three overwrite passes.

## Keywords

## Key files

- `README.md` — installation, usage, shortcuts, security notes.
- `main.js` — Electron main process (window, tray, shortcuts, secure-delete IPC).
- `preload.js` — context-isolated bridge.
- `paper-shredder-widget.html` — complete UI/CSS/animation source.
- `installers/` — local installer copies and SHA256 checksums.

## Testing status

Version 1.0.0 was tested on macOS only. The Windows installer is cross-compiled from the same source but has not been manually tested on Windows.
